description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/engine/data_sources.ex missed 91,96,204,220,225,305,314,323,324,334,431,463,474,572,587,654,656,657. Exclusive test ownership: test/zaq/engine/data_sources_test.exs ONLY; existing WatchChannel schema tests and other suites untouched. No production changes planned. Existing issue check: bw list --all --grep data_sources.ex found none (2026-10-07). Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/services/engine.md Data Sources Runtime/Watch Channel Renewal. Action reuse assessment: not applicable; tests only, no executable operation, Action, workflow, tool, dispatch, public API or documentation changes. Engine DataSources owns durable provider watches/checkpoints; Channels owns provider calls; preserve NodeRouter event boundary. E2E not needed: backend branch regression tests, no new user journey/UI. Functional specification: existing DataSources public contracts for lookup, archive/renew/stop, watch upsert and metadata; no behavior change. Tests to add before implementation: all work is tests, and no production implementation is proposed. Documentation to update: none unless coverage exception requires Beadwork/PR note. Target branches and planned tests:
1. L91: resolve_watch_channel(%{}) or map missing channel_id/target_source -> exact {:error, :missing_channel_id}; map with nonbinary channel_id alone should also fail. L96: provider+target_source unscoped lookup with no active matching watch -> :watch_channel_not_found; include stopped or expired seeded watch to establish exclusion, not only empty table; verify existing other connector does not leak. Existing unknown channel_id test exercises a different branch.
2. L204/L220: call stop_config_watch_channels/1 and reconcile_archived_config_watches/1 with nil, zero, negative, string/noninteger -> exact invalid_connector_id shapes (stop returns {:error,[{nil,:invalid_connector_id}]}, reconcile returns {:error,:invalid_connector_id}); verify no router calls and rows unchanged. L314: archived connector with stopped watch (and separately active watch if useful) -> renew_watch_channel(stopped.id) == :ok; stopped row remains, no archived unwatch event. Current test for stopped/errored renewal uses unarchived connector.
3. L305: realistic teardown race: archive connector; create active watch; narrow router fake responds :ok to :data_source_unwatch_archived_item after deleting that exact watch row in the same SQL sandbox, simulating provider teardown followed by concurrent local deletion; renew_watch_channel(id) returns {:error,:watch_channel_not_found} from mark_watch_channel_stopped, router event matches connector/channel/resource, row absent, no extra calls. Only if the real public path produces this branch without unsafe sandbox ownership or global interference; do not mock Repo or add production test hooks. Optional separate smaller process-backed race if race fake is judged overly artificial.
4. L431: renewal with valid global base URL and an existing active old watch; narrow router fake responds {:ok,%{channel_id: "unpersisted-channel"}} for :data_source_watch_item but does NOT persist replacement -> exact {:error,:replacement_watch_channel_not_persisted}, old row remains and no unwatch event. Existing test title mentions this case but only covers missing channel id, provider error, unexpected reply and unwatch errors.
5. L463: stop_config_watch_channels(config.id) with router fake returning bare :ok for :data_source_unwatch_item -> {:ok,1}, persisted stopped row, event carries expected %Zaq.Event{request: %{params: %{config_id: id, channel_id: ..., resource_id: ...}}} and action; existing stub returns {:ok,payload}.
6. L474: update an existing watch via upsert_watch_channel with blank optional checkpoint/resource_uri plus a real changed field -> blank keys are compacted, original persisted values retained, changed field persisted; assert metadata appropriately rather than requiring overwritten checkpoint. L572: create/upsert with blank optional resource_uri/checkpoint (and required fields valid), then assert blank values are omitted from persisted fields and watch metadata, while valid fields persist. Check whether Ecto defaults represent omission as nil; avoid asserting a value absent from schema contract. L587: upsert with config_id "12x"/"invalid" (valid rest) -> {:error,%Ecto.Changeset{errors: [config_id: ...]}} and no watch persisted; numeric string still resolves existing row as current test proves. If cast behavior differs, assert the actual documented validation/DB error, never force private normalize_config_id.
7. L225/L323/L324/L334 (enqueue failure): reconcile_archived_config_watches/1 must propagate {:error, reason} and stop reducing on a genuine Oban.insert failure; archived upsert/renewal must persist status error and last_error inspect({:cleanup_enqueue_failed, reason}) and return that error; unarchived active upsert with scheduling failure must return the original {:ok, watch}. BUT no existing per-call Oban injection is present: renewal scheduling calls Oban.insert directly with a valid job; Oban.Testing.with_testing_mode(:manual) does not make insert fail. Do not drop tables, replace Repo, mutate shared Oban configuration, or introduce a test-only seam to hit these lines. First investigate a realistic bounded production-failure mechanism (e.g. actual DB failure under a dedicated isolated transaction with predictable error return, not a raised sandbox abort). If none, record these four as unreachable by safe deterministic public-contract tests with reason, ask owner for production-meaningful boundary/error handling or a justified coverage exception. L323/L324 and L334 are opposite archived/unarchived responses to the same failed insert; do not mislabel as covered by a successful job.
8. L654/L656/L657 (watch_metadata_value private): put_watch_metadata receives only fields normalized by MapUtils.read_stringish to binary/nil; process_watch_changes only supplies binary nonblank checkpoint; mapped expiration is DateTime->formatted binary/nil. Thus atom/integer/other clauses cannot currently be reached through public inputs, even if raw attrs carry these types. Existing integer/atom input test covers MapUtils conversion, NOT these private lines. No private-call hacks or production modifications solely for coverage. Document exception/dead-code review; only if an existing legitimate caller passes unnormalized values should a public scenario be added (verify source first).
Fixtures/helpers: reuse insert_data_source_config/0, watch_attrs/2, with_engine_data_sources_env/3, StubRenewalNodeRouter style, Repo and WatchChannel; use unique channel ids, explicit future expiration when needed, deterministic persisted-row assertions; use existing Oban.Testing manual mode around scheduling, assert_enqueued on success. Keep narrow action-specific router fakes in this test file; no blanket NodeRouterMock stub or external network. Existing global Application env router override and persisted System global base URL require current async: false DataCase module with try/after restoration; SQL Sandbox test owner calls fake synchronously; no sleep/polling; assert sent event messages and returned persisted state. If helper grows, consolidate after duplication without obscuring inputs. No additional support files.
Property assessment: existing property on malformed explicit connector IDs covers broad permission/scope-default invariant; expand it only if needed to prove positive numeric vs malformed IDs never widen lookup, bounded generators. Isolated branch/failure and metadata type examples do not justify a Cartesian product property. Verify nil config never implicitly elevates selection to another connector; unscoped ambiguous search fails closed. No new E2E approval gate applies.
Validation (future implementer only; do NOT execute in planning session): run isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/data_sources_test.exs; inspect fresh coverage for the specified lines with approved coverage lifecycle; run mix q through Context Mode; after implementation/review approval invoke coverage-upper for fresh mix coveralls.json then mix coverup, document exceptions; final mix precommit through Context Mode before requesting human approval. Never weaken current assertions. Reassess branch line mapping on current revision. This planning session performs no tests/Git changes.
title: [coverage] Cover Engine DataSources missed branches
